```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Over $135 billion has been saved, contributing to the surplus and prosperity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[0]},{"claim_text":"Trust in government has almost doubled.",

"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[0]},{"claim_text":"Republicans attack public workers and tear down public services.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[0]},{"claim_text":"Government workers have been empowered and public services have been improved.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[0]},{"claim_text":"Citizens will be able to help cut crime in their neighborhood, notify government of potentially dangerous environmental hazards, or sign up for a clinical trial of the latest advances in medicine through the Internet.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This new e-government will break down barriers to service, reduce costs, and make government accessible for all.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Partnerships between labor and management should be forged that recognize the interests of both sides while uniting government workers and managers in a common crusade to improve government performance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Government should have the tools and expertise necessary to provide high-quality services.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Privatization is not a panacea.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Some services are inherently public.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Public employees should be allowed to compete both for their current work and for new work to ensure government works better and costs less.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"When government work is contracted out to private companies, they should adhere to the same level of accountability as public agencies and those arrangements must incorporate labor, safety, health, civil rights, and other important safeguards.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
